notes.text:
(gq) The assemblies indicated by (gq) require a babbitt lining which is poured in
and around a mandrel after brackets and bevel gear case are bolted to
channels, mandrel to pass through bevel gear case bearings to insure
eight main bearings being in line after assembled as listed under Frame,
with brackets and caps assembly. For that reason, the brackets and
caps are issued as individual items without babbitt.

findings: M296 and M299 are distinct inner/outer bushes, two each. Each SNL44 assembly contains one M300 bronze dowel, 5/8 inch diameter by 1/2 inch long. Only the dowel material is specified by these rows.

M290 has six total occurrences in SNL165: four allocated to M289 output shafts and two to the distinct M267 sleeve. Plate22 uses callout3 at the outboard sprocket and inboard planet-disk ends; this candidate selects two rings per output shaft, not two halves in one groove.

Original SNL309 note(gq) specifies babbitt poured into the fixed brackets/caps around an alignment mandrel. The candidate therefore treats M296/M299 as sleeves rotating with the shaft, with their M300 dowels seated into shaft recesses. Dowel direction, drilling and this interface interpretation are hypotheses; the text does not explicitly detail the dowel fit.

Bracket/cap geometry, poured lining, oil fittings, frame/channel attachment and M391 support-foot count conflict remain outside this increment. The source review found two feet in each nested outside-bracket list versus two globally; no new foot quantity is committed here.

Bush lengths/flanges and ring stations use conditional Plate22 proportions from the inherited four-inch M291 hub scale. Bush radii, ring gap, grooves, clearances and dowel drilling remain explicit assumptions. These are not manufacturing dimensions.
